segments.text: Welcome to Radiation Safety Basics.
segments.zh: 欢迎学习辐射安全基础。

segments.text: The purpose of this video is to explore the sources of radiation, dosimetry, and the basic
segments.zh: 本视频的目的是探讨辐射的来源、剂量学，以及

segments.text: biologic effects of radiation.
segments.zh: 辐射的基本生物学效应。

segments.text: So let's get started.
segments.zh: 那我们开始吧。

segments.text: There are two basic sources of radiation, natural sources that include cosmic, where
segments.zh: 辐射有两大基本来源：天然来源，包括宇宙辐射、

segments.text: we get our food, water, or our air, and the ground.
segments.zh: 我们从食物、水或空气中摄入的辐射，以及来自地面的辐射。

segments.text: Man-made radiation comes from the nuclear industry and the ionizing radiation we use
segments.zh: 人工辐射来自核工业，以及我们在

segments.text: in medical imaging.
segments.zh: 医学成像中使用的电离辐射。

segments.text: Let's take a quick look at the annual dose limits.
segments.zh: 我们来快速看一下年剂量限值。

segments.text: The general public is limited to 1 millisievert for continuous exposure and 5 millisieverts
segments.zh: 公众在持续照射下的限值为 1 毫希沃特，而在不经常的照射下

segments.text: for infrequent exposure.
segments.zh: 为 5 毫希沃特。

segments.text: Operators are limited to 50 millisievert or 5 rem a year.
segments.zh: 操作人员的限值是每年 50 毫希沃特，即 5 雷姆。

segments.text: Let's look at some basic dosimetry measurements.
segments.zh: 我们来看一些基本的剂量学测量单位。

segments.text: A red or a gray refers to an absorbed dose.
segments.zh: 拉德（rad）或戈瑞（gray）指的是吸收剂量。

segments.text: Red in fact stands for radiation-absorbed dose.
segments.zh: rad 实际上代表“辐射吸收剂量”（radiation absorbed dose）。

segments.text: A rem or sievert refers to the unit of dose equivalent.
segments.zh: 雷姆或希沃特指的是剂量当量的单位。

segments.text: Rem stands for radiation-equivalent man and is an expression of the biologic response
segments.zh: rem 代表“人体伦琴当量”（radiation equivalent man），它表示的是人体对

segments.text: to radiation.
segments.zh: 辐射的生物学反应。

segments.text: Let's look at some basic biologic effects of radiation.
segments.zh: 我们来看看辐射的一些基本生物学效应。

segments.text: The human response to radiation is dose-dependent.
segments.zh: 人体对辐射的反应取决于剂量。

segments.text: Some cells are more radio-sensitive than others.
segments.zh: 有些细胞比其他细胞对辐射更敏感。

segments.text: Response can be categorized as early effects, effects that are seen in a short time after
segments.zh: 反应可以分为早期效应，即照射后短时间内

segments.text: the exposure, and late effects that may take years to develop.
segments.zh: 出现的效应，以及可能要过好几年才会出现的晚期效应。

segments.text: The laws of Burgonnay and Tribe and Do state high proliferation rate for cells and a high
segments.zh: Bergonié 和 Tribondeau 定律指出，细胞增殖率高、

segments.text: growth rate for tissues result in an increased radio-sensitivity.
segments.zh: 组织生长率高，会导致辐射敏感性增加。

segments.text: This is why we shield gonads when it is all possible and try not to x-ray during
segments.zh: 这就是为什么只要有可能我们都会屏蔽性腺，并尽量避免在

segments.text: the first trimester of pregnancy.
segments.zh: 怀孕头三个月做 X 射线检查。

segments.text: The early effects of radiation include acute radiation syndrome, local tissue damage, hematologic
segments.zh: 辐射的早期效应包括急性放射综合征、局部组织损伤、造血

segments.text: depression, and cytogenic damage.
segments.zh: 抑制以及细胞遗传学损伤。

segments.text: An early response occurs within minutes or days after radiation exposure.
segments.zh: 早期反应发生在受照后几分钟到几天内。

segments.text: When performed properly, these effects are never seen in general x-ray.
segments.zh: 如果操作得当，这些效应在普通 X 射线检查中是绝不会出现的。

segments.text: Late effects of radiation happen months or years after exposure.
segments.zh: 辐射的晚期效应发生在受照后几个月或几年。

segments.text: Both early and late effects need a high dose of radiation to occur, but we should be always
segments.zh: 早期和晚期效应都需要高剂量辐射才会发生，但我们应该始终

segments.text: ever cautious and assume even small doses are harmful, since dose is cumulative.
segments.zh: 保持谨慎，假定即使是小剂量也是有害的，因为剂量是会累积的。

segments.text: There are many examples of local tissue damage by radiation.
segments.zh: 辐射造成局部组织损伤的例子有很多。

segments.text: The first is erythema, or skin reddening.
segments.zh: 第一个是红斑，也就是皮肤发红。

segments.text: This response is followed by desquamicization, which is a form of skin ulceration.
segments.zh: 这种反应之后会出现脱皮，这是皮肤溃疡的一种形式。

segments.text: The gonads are affected, in particular the sperm in the ooze sites, and these are the
segments.zh: 性腺会受到影响，尤其是精子和卵母细胞，它们是

segments.text: most radio-sensitive cells while they are in the stem cells phase.
segments.zh: 处于干细胞阶段时对辐射最敏感的细胞。

segments.text: Key biologic factors that affect radio-sensitivity include the oxygen effect, age, recovery,
segments.zh: 影响辐射敏感性的关键生物学因素包括氧效应、年龄、恢复

segments.text: and chemical agents.
segments.zh: 以及化学制剂。

segments.text: The oxygen effect says tissues are more sensitive to radiation in oxygen.
segments.zh: 氧效应是指，组织在有氧条件下对辐射更敏感。

segments.text: Diagnostic x-ray imaging is performed under full oxygenization conditions.
segments.zh: 诊断 X 射线成像是在充分氧合的条件下进行的。

segments.text: The age of the biologic structures affect the radio-sensitivity as well, with newest
segments.zh: 生物结构的年龄也会影响辐射敏感性，最新的、

segments.text: youngest being most radio-sensitive.
segments.zh: 最年轻的结构对辐射最敏感。

segments.text: History demonstrates cells can recover from radiation damage if the dose is not sufficient
segments.zh: 历史表明，如果剂量一开始就不足以杀死细胞，

segments.text: enough to kill the cell in the first place.
segments.zh: 细胞是能够从辐射损伤中恢复的。

segments.text: And there are some chemicals that can modify radiation response.
segments.zh: 还有一些化学物质可以改变辐射反应。

segments.text: Radioprotector chemicals are not used in humans, unfortunately, because their increased dose
segments.zh: 遗憾的是，辐射防护剂不用于人体，因为加大剂量

segments.text: tends to kill the host.
segments.zh: 往往会杀死宿主。

segments.text: When looking at dose-response relationships, a linear dose-response relationship is directly
segments.zh: 在看剂量—反应关系时，线性剂量—反应关系在画到图上时

segments.text: proportional to the dose-response when you put it on a graph and can have a threshold
segments.zh: 与剂量—反应成正比，它可以有阈值，

segments.text: or not.
segments.zh: 也可以没有。

segments.text: A threshold-response will occur at some specified value on the chart that is greater than zero.
segments.zh: 阈值反应会在图上某个大于零的特定值处出现。

segments.text: A non-threshold response will occur at any point, regardless of the size of the dose.
segments.zh: 无阈值反应则在任何一点都会出现，无论剂量大小。

segments.text: Linear responses are not directly proportional, and they create a curved line on the chart.
segments.zh: 线性反应不是成正比的，它们在图上形成一条曲线。

segments.text: So just remember, a linear will cause a straight line on your charts, non-linear will cause
segments.zh: 所以只要记住，线性的在图上是一条直线，非线性的则是

segments.text: a curved line.
segments.zh: 一条曲线。

segments.text: Because the human body is an aqueous solution containing about 80% water, a radiation of
segments.zh: 由于人体是一种含有约 80% 水的水溶液，水受到照射

segments.text: water is the principal radiation interaction in the body.
segments.zh: 是体内最主要的辐射相互作用。

segments.text: When water is irradiated, it disassociates into other molecular products.
segments.zh: 水受到照射时，会分解成其他分子产物。

segments.text: This is called the radiolisis of water.
segments.zh: 这叫做水的辐射分解。

segments.text: Let's look at direct and indirect effects.
segments.zh: 我们来看看直接效应和间接效应。

segments.text: If the initial ionizing event occurs on the target molecule, like a DNA, it is a direct
segments.zh: 如果最初的电离事件发生在靶分子上，比如 DNA，那就是直接

segments.text: effect.
segments.zh: 效应。

segments.text: DNA is a critical target.
segments.zh: DNA 是一个关键靶点。

segments.text: If it occurs on a distant non-critical molecule, it is an indirect effect.
segments.zh: 如果它发生在远处的非关键分子上，那就是间接效应。

segments.text: The principal effect on humans is indirect, as in radiolisis.
segments.zh: 对人体的主要效应是间接效应，比如辐射分解。

segments.text: Low chronic irradiation does not impair fertility.
segments.zh: 低剂量的慢性照射不会损害生育能力。

segments.text: All observations point to the first trimester as the most radiosensitive period, in particular
segments.zh: 所有观察结果都表明，怀孕头三个月是对辐射最敏感的时期，尤其是

segments.text: the first two weeks.
segments.zh: 头两周。

segments.text: During the period of major organ formation, during weeks 2-10, two effects can occur, skeletal
segments.zh: 在主要器官形成期，也就是第 2 到 10 周，可能出现两种效应：骨骼

segments.text: and organ abnormalities.
segments.zh: 异常和器官异常。

segments.text: And the relative risk of leukemia is a risk of 1.5, which is small.
segments.zh: 白血病的相对风险是 1.5，这个风险很小。

segments.text: Genetic effects are linear and non-threshold.
segments.zh: 遗传效应是线性、无阈值的。

segments.text: Any dose has risk.
segments.zh: 任何剂量都有风险。

segments.text: Frequency of radiation induced is low.
segments.zh: 辐射诱发的频率很低。

segments.text: In late effects, we have latent periods.
segments.zh: 晚期效应有潜伏期。

segments.text: These include cataracts with a latent period of 5-30 years, leukemia of 4-7 years, and
segments.zh: 其中包括白内障，潜伏期为 5 到 30 年；白血病为 4 到 7 年，而且

segments.text: they're still at risk after 20 years, thyroid cancer for about 20 years.
segments.zh: 20 年后仍有风险；甲状腺癌大约为 20 年。

segments.text: There are only 8 cases per 10,000 people irradiated with one rad of radiation for
segments.zh: 每 10,000 名受到 1 拉德辐射照射的人中，

segments.text: total cases of risk of malignancy.
segments.zh: 恶性肿瘤风险的总病例只有 8 例。

segments.text: I want to thank you all for joining me.
segments.zh: 感谢大家和我一起学习。

segments.text: Come back, read your book.
segments.zh: 回去好好读读你们的课本。

segments.text: A lot of this information came directly from Bichon, so good luck to you, and good luck
segments.zh: 这里的很多信息直接来自 Bushong 的书，所以祝你们好运，祝你们

segments.text: on that test.
segments.zh: 考试顺利。
